DOWNFALL / ROUTE ZERO / STILLS v1

Route Zero stills

The real character model, posed and lit for the story. Faceless on purpose: the body and the mask do the acting. Each image is rendered straight from the game's own character editor, so these are the stand-ins an artist or an image tool should match, not exceed.

Rough props (card, crystal, sign, lamp) are placeholders. They show where things sit and what the light does. The cleaner version of each frame belongs to the art pass.

The story, in poses

One scene, four masks

The same two moments, resolve and joy, played by each mask. No face anywhere. This is the casting sheet: it shows which mask is funniest where.
